definitions.explanation: The perspective of viewing things from outside oneself, without personal bias or emotional involvement. Contrasts with subjectivity.

examples.japanese: {客観|きゃっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{客観|きゃっかん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{主観|しゅかん}→主観：11466_shukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To strike a balance between objectivity and subjectivity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{客観|きゃっかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It is not easy to view things from an objective standpoint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{客観|きゃっかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいた→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Researchers are expected to provide analysis grounded in objectivity.

notes:
Refers to the standpoint of evaluating or observing things impartially, without personal feelings or prejudice. Frequently appears in academic, journalistic, and philosophical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {客観|きゃっかん}的（な）: objective (adjective form, extremely common)
- {客観|きゃっかん}的⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at objectively
- {客観|きゃっかん}的⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: objective fact
- {客観|きゃっかん}性（⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧）: objectivity (to maintain objectivity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主観|しゅかん}→主観：11466_shukan⟧: subjectivity — the direct opposite; personal, subjective viewpoint
- ⟦{中立|ちゅうりつ}→中立：11324_chuuritsu⟧: neutrality — not taking sides, but not necessarily the same as being objective
- ⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧: fairness — emphasizes impartial treatment, often in legal or institutional contexts

FORMS:
⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (guest, outsider) + {観|かん} (view) — literally "viewing as an outsider," i.e., seeing from a detached perspective.
